description: Source code for TransportConnectSubJob class and WebSocketStreamSocket wrapper, handling socket connection logic, endpoint locking, and socket performance monitoring within Chromium's networking stack.

classes.name: WebSocketStreamSocket
classes.description: A wrapper around StreamSocket that manages registration with WebSocketEndpointLockManager on creation/destruction.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Initiates the connection process, starting with obtaining an endpoint lock.

methods.name: GotEndpointLock
methods.description: Callback invoked when the WebSocket endpoint lock is acquired.

methods.name: GetLoadState
methods.description: Returns current load state based on connection process.

methods.name: CurrentAddress
methods.description: Returns the current address being connected to.

methods.name: OnIOComplete
methods.description: Handles completion of asynchronous IO operations.

methods.name: DoLoop
methods.description: Main loop managing connection states and transitions.

methods.name: DoEndpointLock
methods.description: Attempts to acquire an endpoint lock if applicable.

methods.name: DoEndpointLockComplete
methods.description: Completes endpoint lock acquisition and initiates socket connection.

methods.name: DoTransportConnectComplete
methods.description: Handles completion of socket connection attempt, manages retries or success.
